title: Storm Sorceress
description: A blue-skinned sorceress with flowing blue hair and robes stands on a rocky outcrop above the sea, holding a glowing orb staff in one hand while raising the other. She is surrounded by a massive magical vortex of swirling blue water and golden light that pulls in fish, birds, and two sailing ships, under a dramatic stormy sky with purple clouds and lightning.
prompt: A powerful blue-skinned female sorceress with long flowing blue hair and ornate blue robes stands on a rocky cliff by the ocean, holding a glowing blue orb staff, one hand raised commanding magic. A giant swirling vortex of turquoise and blue water with golden highlights spirals around her, pulling in fish, seabirds, and two old wooden sailing ships. Dramatic stormy sky filled with dark purple and black clouds and bright blue lightning strikes. Highly detailed fantasy seascape, cinematic lighting.
